The *it* of *For it is all my salvation* is the supplied subject of a verbless clause that writes no subject word of its own, and it denotes the covenant this noun names, so it belongs to this noun's one discontinuous unit under rule 25, exactly as `וְעֵץ חַיִּים תַּאֲוָה בָאָה` → *it is a tree of life* gives its *it* to `תַּאֲוָה`. Head on the word writing the lexeme (rule 25). The later *it* of *he maketh it not to grow* is not here: that one completes an English verb's valency where the Hebrew writes no object morpheme, so rule 44 governs it and it is `added`. The competing reading marks this pronoun `added` too, under rule 20's closing sentence.

Supplied object pronoun: `yaṣmîaḥ` carries no object suffix and no object marker stands in the clause, so the English verb reaches its object only through a word the ASV has written, which is `added` under rule 44's supplied-object clause. That the covenant is named earlier in the verse does not make this a resumption under rule 25: what that rule places is a further realization of the nominal itself — the subject *it* of *For it is all my salvation*, which stays with `bərîṯ` — and not a pronoun supplied to complete an English verb's valency. 2SA.23.16 marks *took it* and *brought it* the same way.

review_notes: The alternative marginal rendering, which turns the whole verse into questions, was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).

The verse writes two supplied *it*s and they are placed differently, by what each completes rather than by what each denotes. The subject *it* of *For it is all my salvation* fills a subject slot the Hebrew clause leaves empty and denotes the covenant the verse names, so it joins `bərîṯ` under rule 25. The object *it* of *he maketh it not to grow* completes the English verb's valency where no object morpheme stands, so it is `added` under rule 44, as 2SA.23.16 marks *took it* and *brought it*.
Corrected at chapter reconciliation: the earlier alignment gave both pronouns to `bərîṯ`, which put this verse at odds with 2SA.23.16 on one and the same construction.
